theorems.name: Submission.tgc_local_graph_closed_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L r : ℝ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (E : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < r → (∀ y ∈ E, ∀ z ∈ E, ‖y - z‖ ≤ r → ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → ∃ Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∃ i, x ∈ Γ i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
